Six things costing you calls

Each of these is on your homepage today. None of them is hard to fix.

  • 1

    Your reviews section is empty

    You have 4.9 stars from 235 Google reviews, but the “Our Reviews” block on your homepage shows only a background image.

  • 2

    31 seconds to load on a phone

    Google’s own speed test scores your homepage 26 out of 100 on mobile. The main image takes 31.5 seconds to appear. Most people leave after 3.

  • 3

    Two different phone numbers

    (480) 838-8850 in the header and on your trucks, (480) 999-9417 in the contact section. Customers don’t know which to call.

  • 4

    Leftover file name on the page

    The text “Screenshot 2023-09-06 145651.png” shows up as page content.

  • 5

    Two web addresses

    Pages live on both qualityovhd.com and a squarespace.com address, which splits your Google ranking.

  • 6

    Closes at 3pm

    Hours are Monday–Friday, 7am–3pm. Without an online request form, evening and weekend searchers call someone else.

Garage door acting up? Our $85 service call includes a 20-point inspection and half an hour of labor, so you know exactly what's wrong before you spend more. Family-run, women-owned and licensed (ROC #310144). Call (480) 838-8850.

Facebook / Instagram caption

Second generation. Women-owned. Serving the Valley since 1996. From home springs to loading docks, Quality Overhead Door has you covered. ⭐ 4.9 from 235 Google reviews. Book your $85 service call: (480) 838-8850 #MesaAZ #WomenOwnedBusiness #GarageDoorRepair #EastValley

Website article

What does an $85 garage door service call include? A 20-point inspection: springs, cables, rollers, tracks, hinges, opener, sensors and balance. Half an hour of labor: enough for most adjustments, lubrication and small fixes on the spot. A clear quote: if a part needs replacing, you'll know the price before we start. Parts are extra. Why it matters: most expensive breakdowns start as a worn roller or an unbalanced door. A yearly check catches them early. Book yours at (480) 838-8850.
